Finding: Upstream Vellvm embedded 7 GPL-3.0+ CLI/test driver files and CompCert's GPL-2.0 Camlcoq.ml which would infect commercial distributions
Action: Stripped all GPL-3.0+/GPL-2.0 files during import and wrote a clean-room Camlcoq.ml under LLVMCert license

Finding: Upstream Vellvm carried a stale GPL-2.0 header on Zbits.v whereas upstream CompCert relicensed lib/Zbits.v under LGPL-2.1-or-later
Action: Synchronized Zbits.v license header with upstream CompCert commit 04f499c632a7 (LGPL-2.1-or-later)

Finding: Vellvm 3.0 refactored Numeric/Integers.v from Int/Int64 functors to width-indexed bit_int ({wordsize: positive}); initial Camlcoq.ml referenced Integers.Int.int
Action: Updated Camlcoq.ml to use Integers.bit_int with explicit P.of_int 32 and P.of_int 64 width arguments

Finding: Extracted library dune file required (instrumentation (backend bisect_ppx)) although bisect_ppx is absent from rocq-vellvm.opam
Action: Removed bisect_ppx instrumentation stanza so dune build succeeds cleanly from rocq-vellvm.opam dependencies

Finding: Two upstream Rocq axioms exist in Vellvm (Integers.wordsize_not_zero and ParserHelper.Zlog2_log_inf)
Action: Explicitly allowlisted both in scripts/verify_repo_integrity.py while blocking any new Axiom/Conjecture/Admitted; evaluate discharging Zlog2_log_inf in Phase 2

Finding: Upstream SurfaceSyntax.v contains two interactive Goal ... Abort blocks inside Section SurfaceSyntaxTest for notation inspection
Action: Scoped Abort exemption strictly to SurfaceSyntax.v while forbidding Abort in all LLVMCert passes/ and validator/ proofs

Finding: LLVM 23.1.5 LLVMTargetParser unconditionally invokes llvm-min-tblgen on ARM/ARM.td and PowerPC/PPC.td even when LLVM_TARGETS_TO_BUILD=AArch64;RISCV
Action: Retained minimal .td TableGen specs under llvm/lib/Target/{ARM,PowerPC} and froze upstream tree against accidental edits

Finding: LLVM 21-23 introduced IR flags not yet modeled in Vellvm 3.0 (zext nneg / or disjoint / trunc nuw-nsw / icmp samesign / gep nusw-nuw)
Action: Track exact LLVM 20-to-23.1.5 instruction flag delta as Phase 2.1 work item before proving Safe-Path passes

Finding: Upstream Tactics.v imports ITree.Eq.EqAxiom (bisimulation_is_eq in force_rewrite) and proves inj_pair2/subst_existT via JMeq.JMeq_eq (used in DynamicValues.v:444-469), while IPtrFinite.v:139 and I2F_exp.v:1196 import ProofIrrelevance; regex Axiom scanning and rocq chk on TopLevel alone miss library axioms in Theory/passes/validator
Action: Banned force_rewrite and subst_existT in plan/rocq-proof-strategies.md [PS-08] in favor of Eqdep_dec.inj_pair2_eq_dec; extend rocq chk and Print Assumptions gates in Phase 2 to cover Theory, passes, and validator

Finding: DynamicValues.v seals dvalue_bv_eq_dec (:447) and operator deciders ibinop_eq_dec..conversion_type_eq_dec (:547-575) with Qed. instead of Defined., blocking in-Rocq vm_compute reduction of dvalue_eqb/dvalue_eq_dec and requiring Set Extraction AccessOpaque in Extract.v:30
Action: Documented in plan/rocq-proof-strategies.md [PS-05] so passes/ and validator/ implement transparent structural bool comparators with separate Qed. reflection lemmas

Finding: Aikido SAST flagged unpinned GitHub Action version tags and default persist-credentials=true on actions/checkout across workflows
Action: Pinned every GitHub Action to verified 40-char commit SHAs + set persist-credentials: false + enforced both invariants in scripts/verify_repo_integrity.py

Finding: ocaml/setup-ocaml opam-pin performed a slow 192 MB rsync without installing rocq-vellvm deps, and prefix restore-keys on .vo caches risked stale mtimes under GNU make
Action: Disabled opam-pin + cached _opam with save-always + added explicit opam install --deps-only + switched .vo cache to exact hashFiles key + enabled DUNE_CACHE

Finding: Windows checkout committed CRLF line endings in config.guess and _RocqProject and stripped +x bit on config.guess causing Linux /bin/sh failure during CMake configure
Action: Added .gitattributes (* text=auto eol=lf) + renormalized config.guess and _RocqProject to LF + restored +x bit + passed explicit -DLLVM_HOST_TRIPLE
